note: WDLL 51. Main commercial and light-industrial scalar rows transcribed from official Ordinance 2024-18, Appendix II, at https://mcclibraryfunctions-stage.azurewebsites.us/api/ordinanceDownload/11173/1309249/pdf (accessed 2026-07-23). side_corner_ft mirrors base side only as a non-binding sentinel; the appendix does not give a separate corner-side field. RLD uses SF-1, the sole Allowed development type. RMD and RHD use conservative envelopes: max front/side/rear across Appendix I types Allowed by-right (RMD SF-1/SF-2/DF-1/PH-1 => F25/S10/R20; RHD including CF-1/MF-1 abutting-R => F25/S20/R25). Envelope is intentionally stricter than some allowed types and is not a development-type election. OMITTED: CCB alley/end conditions; IH variable triggers; MH corner/adjacent-lot rules; AO, PI, PDD; two-story-adjacency, drive-through, and block-average exceptions in notes 5, 6, and 10. P-299 OT-1 (height-flag reconciliation, 2026-09-17): every max_height_ft row in this file that carried not_specified was re-read against its own provenance quote and classified with this repo's not_specified-meaning instrument (doc_repo scripts/corpus_not_specified_audit.py, OPS-21-R1). SENTINEL NORMALIZED to the canonical 999 (rule G7) -- the row's own quote states no feet-based limit (stories-only, "none", an absent height subsection, or a placeholder-shaped value in a mixed group), so the flagged number was a placeholder a flag-dropping reader would take for a real height: RLD Residential Low Density (SF-1 baseline) (100 -> 999); RMD Residential Medium Density (conservative allowed-type envelope) (100 -> 999); RHD Residential High Density (conservative allowed-type envelope) (100 -> 999). OF THOSE, RECORDED AS RESIDUALLY UNCERTAIN (placeholder-shaped value inside a group of real transcribed values; the value is not quotable in feet from the text read here, so the canonical sentinel is carried rather than a guess -- this is an adjudication, not a re-read at source, and is the first thing to re-check if a limit later surfaces): RLD Residential Low Density (SF-1 baseline); RMD Residential Medium Density (conservative allowed-type envelope); RHD Residential High Density (conservative allowed-type envelope). FLAG REMOVED, VALUE KEPT -- here the FLAG was the defect and the number was real; not_specified on these rows asserted a false absence. The basis is stated PER ROW because it is not the same for all of them: for these rows the quote names the tabulated height column without restating the number, so the basis is the OPS-21-R1 / P-146 instrument's classification REAL_VALUE_FLAGGED -- the values across that row's flagged siblings are VARIED (transcribed numbers, not one uniform placeholder), which is the discriminator the ruling names (CLB Light Business (keeps 60); CMB Medium Business (keeps 60); CHB Heavy Business (keeps 60); IL Light Industrial (keeps 50)).
